about_the_game:
You find yourself trapped in an abandoned school classroom, where space is warped, and anomalies lurk in the most unexpected places. Find them to escape — but beware: every choice leads to unpredictable consequences. Psychological tension, hidden threats, and a growing sense of dread will haunt you until the very end.

Game Features

  • Attention and Memory Challenge: Memorize the room’s details to spot changes and uncover anomalies later.

  • Anomaly Hunting: From subtle shifts to blatant distortions of reality.

  • Eerie Atmosphere: An abandoned classroom, chilling sounds, and a constant feeling of being watched.

  • Unpredictable Traps: Every action triggers events that can alter the game’s course.

  • Story Through Notes: Uncover what happened in the classroom and why you’re here.

  • One Exit, Many Paths: But not every path leads to freedom.

Your task is simple — observe, remember, decide. But know this: this classroom hides more than meets the eye.

content_descriptors.notes: Warning: This game contains textual descriptions of extreme violence and psychological distress in notes and diaries, which may be unsuitable for some players.
